news.headline: Nations League: Zinedine Zidane balances surprise and continuity in his second roster
news.summary: Zinedine Zidane has unveiled his France squad for the upcoming Nations League clashes against Italy and Turkey. Pablo Pagis earns a surprise first call-up, while Kylian Mbappé and several other key players return from injury
